title: Insurance claims
description: Payer receivables, claim batches, responses, and payments.

resolution.rebilled: Rejected part rebilled to the patient

standingHint.bank: The money is in the bank and the claims it paid are reduced.
standingHint.cash: The cash is in your open shift and counts in its drawer.
standingHint.cheque_pending: The cheque is recorded. Clear it when the bank credits it.
standingHint.cheque_cleared: The cheque cleared and the money is in the bank.

receivables.title: Payer receivables
receivables.description: What each payer owes, from the approved invoice to the payer payment. A payer share is not money until the payer pays.
receivables.receivableHint: Accrued, claimed, accepted and rejected amounts not yet settled
receivables.accruedHint: Payer shares of approved invoices not yet on a claim
receivables.claimedHint: On claims sent to payers, waiting for an answer
receivables.rejectedBody: was rejected by payers. Rebill each rejected part to the patient or write it off.

list.title: Claims
list.description: Claim batches by payer and period, with what each still has to collect.

build.title: Build a claim
build.description: Choose a payer and a period of invoice approval dates, then the payer shares to claim.
build.noPayerHint: Its unclaimed shares in the period appear here.
build.emptyHint: This payer has no unclaimed shares approved in this period.

detail.title: Claim {{number, bidi}}
detail.submitTitle: Mark this claim as sent to the payer?
detail.submitDescription: Send the exported claim to the payer first. After this, lines cannot be removed; the payer's answers are entered per line.
detail.acceptAllDescription_one: The remaining line is recorded as accepted in full.
detail.acceptAllDescription_other: All {{count}} remaining lines are recorded as accepted in full.
detail.closeDescription: A claim closes once every line is paid, rebilled or written off. A closed claim never changes.
detail.voidDescription: Only a claim the payer has not answered can be voided. Its lines can be claimed again.
detail.removeTitle: Remove this line from the claim?
detail.removeDescription: Its payer share stays unclaimed and can go on a later claim.
detail.noPayments: No payer payment has been allocated to this claim.

response.title: Payer's answer
response.description: Enter what the payer accepted for this line. Any rejected part needs the payer's reason.

resolve.rebillTitle: Rebill the rejected part to the patient
resolve.rebillDescription: The patient will owe this amount on the original invoice. The invoice itself does not change.
resolve.writeOffDescription: The center absorbs this amount. The write-off records you as approver, the reason and the time.

shortfall.title: Write off an unpaid accepted amount
shortfall.description: For money the payer accepted but will not pay (deductions, withholding). The write-off records you as approver, the reason and the time.

payments.title: Payer payments
payments.description: Money received from payers and the claims it paid. Cheques count as money only once cleared.
payments.recordDescription: The whole amount is allocated to the payer's accepted claim amounts.
payments.cashIntoShift: The cash goes into your open shift {{shift, bidi}}.
payments.cashNeedsShift: Cash needs your own open shift. Record transfers and cheques without one.
payments.nothingPayable: This payer has no accepted amounts left to pay.
payments.unbalanced: The amounts per claim must add up to the payment amount.
payments.clearDescription: Confirm the bank credited the cheque. The money moves from pending to the bank.
payments.reverseDescription: For a transfer or cheque that bounced or was recorded by mistake. The claims it paid owe again.

aging.title: Payer aging
aging.description: What payers still owe, by days since the invoice was approved.

print.pageDescription: The claim in the payer layout, on A4.
print.title: Insurance claim

validation.amount: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
validation.partialRange: A partial answer accepts more than zero and less than the claimed amount.
validation.payerReason: Enter the payer's reason for the rejected part.
validation.atMostUnpaid: The amount cannot be more than the unpaid accepted amount.
validation.period: The period must end on or after its start.
